newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BERLUSCONI GIVES MILAN PEP TALK BEFORE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BERLUSCONI GIVES MILAN PEP TALK BEFORE MATCH.

text.p: AC Milan owner Silvio Berlusconi, in a pep talk before Sunday's Serie A clash against second-placed Sampdoria, told his players to believe in themselves and they would return to the top.
"I don't believe the crisis at Milan is very deep," Berlusconi was quoted as saying in Gazzetta dello Sport.

"Like everbody, I see our results and our game and it makes me worry. But this situation can be fixed in a short time -- we have the whole second half of the season to look forward to," added the former prime minister.
"Milan does not have to be rebuilt. These players can do anything they want -- it depends on their will."
Milan, league champions last season, are languishing in 10th place in Serie A after a disastrous first half of the season in which they were eliminated from the Champions' League and Italian Cup.
Francesco Coco, a 19-year-old defender who is set to start against Sampdoria at San Siro stadium, said Berlusconi's talk had encouraged all the players.
"He is very charismatic and after the talk with him we all came out very enthusiastic. He let us know that we are still the best team out there," Coco told Gazzetta.
